findings.summary: Source ledger validation accepts unproven cross-tenant channel bindings
findings.details: S05-T01 requires stable tenant keys plus rejection of missing organization/channel bindings and cross-org channels before tenant writes. The implemented validator has no authoritative binding input and only checks that channelKey text ends with externalChannelId text; any non-empty organizationKey/connectionKey paired with a syntactically matching channelKey is accepted. The regression test even treats a different organization using the same channel/provider object as a valid inserted capture. A future capture path using this contract can write source ledger rows for a channel not actually bound to the organization/connection, so this must be reworked to require and verify the S04 organization/connection/channel generation binding (or equivalent verified binding snapshot) and test missing/cross-org bindings as rejection, not merely different key derivation.
